changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT sal.id, mrr.resource_id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles sal JOIN role_resources mrr ON mrr.role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'MANAGER') JOIN role_resource_operations mrro ON mrro.role_resource_id = mrr.id JOIN operations o ON o.id = mrro.operation_id AND o.code = 'READ' WHERE sal.code = 'SALESMAN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources srr WHERE srr.role_id = sal.id AND srr.resource_id = mrr.resource_id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT srr.id, o.id FROM role_resources srr JOIN roles sal ON srr.role_id = sal.id AND sal.code = 'SALESMAN' JOIN operations o ON o.code = 'READ' JOIN role_resources mrr ON mrr.resource_id = srr.resource_id AND mrr.role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'MANAGER') JOIN role_resource_operations mrro ON mrro.role_resource_id = mrr.id AND mrro.operation_id = o.id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations srro WHERE srro.role_resource_id = srr.id AND srro.operation_id = o.id );

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roles WHERE code = 'SALESMAN'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'SALESMAN' AND res.code = 'OFFERS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r2 ON rr.role_id = r2.id JOIN resources res2 ON rr.resource_id = res2.id WHERE r2.code = 'SALESMAN' AND res2.code = 'OFFERS' );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('READ', 'CREATE', 'UPDATE') WHERE r.code = 'SALESMAN' AND res.code = 'OFFERS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations rro WHERE rro.role_resource_id = rr.id AND rro.operation_id = o.id );

INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'SALESMAN' AND res.code = 'SIGNABLE_DOCUMENTS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r2 ON rr.role_id = r2.id JOIN resources res2 ON rr.resource_id = res2.id WHERE r2.code = 'SALESMAN' AND res2.code = 'SIGNABLE_DOCUMENTS' );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('READ', 'CREATE', 'UPDATE') WHERE r.code = 'SALESMAN' AND res.code = 'SIGNABLE_DOCUMENTS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations rro WHERE rro.role_resource_id = rr.id AND rro.operation_id = o.id );
